about: Per-slot head decisions for the 35 retail-moment rosters (tools/b77/fs1_scans_plan.py). keep = the retail record is untouched; retail = the person's own retail record (photo id, whole skin value, face, dreads); relocate = the same, the head id being the unused one of nfl2k5_moment_scans; generic = no scan exists and the slot held another person's head, so it takes the no-photo id (7100 + slot).
